subject.title: feat(gateway): add context engine control API

question: Should OpenClaw expose context-engine capabilities, status, doctor, and rotate as a core Gateway/plugin control API after the session-targeting blocker is fixed?
rationale: The canonicalization bug is mechanical, but the PR creates a new public Gateway surface and optional ContextEngine plugin contract with admin rotate semantics that need maintainer API intent.

options.title: Approve after scoping fix
options.body: Keep the proposed core API direction, but require canonical session targeting, focused regression tests, conflict resolution, and maintainer-reviewed scope/docs semantics before merge.

options.title: Narrow to read-only control
options.body: Land only capabilities/status/doctor first and defer admin rotate until maintainers are ready to own that operator action.

options.title: Pause the core API
options.body: Hold or close the PR if context-engine maintenance control should remain plugin-owned until a broader Gateway control contract exists.

recommendation.title: Approve after scoping fix
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed core API direction, but require canonical session targeting, focused regression tests, conflict resolution, and maintainer-reviewed scope/docs semantics before merge.
